title: See the traffic your radar sees.

views.label: 5 s
views.title: Forward range / left distance · colour = reported relative speed
views.note: Real radar targets decoded from CAN. Relative speed is the upstream reported channel, not raw Doppler or a native ego-velocity fit. Manual yaw rotates the reported target coordinates only; no extrinsic accuracy is asserted.
